column2: Update: my initial pin attempt to 2.4.4 broke the install (the versioned download URL 403s without CS_ACCESS_TOKEN on the install step — only the `latest` redirect is public). Reverted that part in 069eb03 and added a header comment explaining the tradeoff. The right fix is to pass CS_ACCESS_TOKEN to the install step (mirroring what the delta job already does) and then pin a known-good version; filing that as a follow-up. For now the `cs delta --error-on-warnings` job still blocks on findings, and the GitHub App + quality-gate profile remain the deterministic layer.
